subject: AWS Marketplace: Usage stories and field enablement binder
messages:
From: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmecorp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Partner Rep <aws-marketplace-partner@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace enablement request: usage stories + field kit

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. The Acme field team asked for a short, shareable binder they can use during co-sell calls that: 1) summarizes technical usage scenarios by persona, 2) includes two short customer-facing usage story cards, and 3) outlines the trial flow people can follow in the AWS UI.

Can Redwood provide a lightweight "enablement binder" and the usage story cards so the field can use them in next week's enablement? If you can share a draft (PDF and a simple spreadsheet for the cards) we can iterate.

Separately, AWS asked if there are any claim/value statements we want to pre-clear for the listing (e.g., unit-cost numbers or latency benchmarks). The field wants one-liners they can use in calls.

Appreciate your help — Sara
Senior Product Manager
Acme Corp

---
Attachments: none
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, AWS Partner Rep <aws-marketplace-partner@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace enablement request: usage stories + field kit

Sara — thanks for the clear ask. We've put together an initial draft of the enablement binder and the usage-story cards (attached). High level:

- Enablement binder (PDF): 6 slides covering overview, 3 persona-driven usage scenarios (Developer, Platform Team, Product Manager), trial steps in AWS Marketplace, and suggested customer questions for sellers.
- Usage story cards (xlsx): 4 card templates (short blurb, problem statement, how Redwood solves it, suggested demo prompt).
- Claim guidance: included a 1-line set for each persona; we avoided specific latency numbers unless you prefer an explicit benchmark callout — we can add Redwood-verified median p50 latency for the hosted API per model if needed.

Next steps I propose: Kimberly and Jonas take a pass on copy/claims, then we share to you and AWS for pre-clear. If that works I'll circulate an updated binder by tomorrow morning.

Evelyn Hart
Partner Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: enablement-binder-v1.pdf (pdf), usage-story-cards.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 18:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace enablement request: usage stories + field kit

Eve / team — quick copy pass and compliance flags below. I'm pasting the short comments inline for traceability.

1) One-liners / claims:
- Current draft has: "Consistent p50 latency under 300ms for common generation tasks."
  - Suggestion: change to "Typical p50 latency in real-world tests: ~300ms for short completion tasks (varies by model and sequence length)." — softer language reduces hard SLAs in marketing copy.
2) Trial flow copy: please add a very short bullet that clarifies "trial provisions are billed through AWS Marketplace; trial capacity may differ from production Dedicated seats."
3) Usage stories: good, but add a short customer outcome metric (e.g., "reduced inference cost by ~40% on batch workloads") where we have evidence.

I'll make the small edits in the binder and re-upload. Jonas — can you confirm there are no technical claims that need legal sign-off?

Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

A couple of quick asks before the field session: 1) can you soften the p50 language as Kimberly suggested, 2) include a one-slide "How to start the trial" that points to the AWS trial button and next steps, and 3) can you share the binder as a Google PDF link so we can drop it into our enablement LMS?

If you can get the edits and the Drive link by EOD Pacific today we'll load it into our enablement materials for next week's training.

Appreciate it — Sara
